en.title: Add Drex Max Finance
en.description: For financial decisions with text and images. Select drex-max-finance in Nace settings; the whole-request limit is 262k tokens.

en.title: Clarify Clef media support
en.description: Clef, Clef-flash, and Clef-omni support text decisions; choose Clef-omni for audio and video.

en.title: Support local Laya 0.4.26 servers
en.description: Connect to Laya 0.4.26 for local Chinese yes/no decisions, classification, and scoring.
